accepted.cause: Non-transaction revenue growth driven by surveillance and new entity ratings
accepted.effect: estimate revision upside on recurring fee expansion
accepted.evidence_span: Non-transaction revenue increased 11% to $380 million due to growth in fees associated with surveillance as well as large increases in new entity ratings and Rating Evaluation Service fees.

accepted.cause: International revenue growth led by EMEA and Asia-Pacific gains
accepted.effect: geographic diversification strengthens revenue stability outlook
accepted.evidence_span: revenue increased 1% and international revenue, led by gains in EMEA and Asia-Pacific, increased 10% .

accepted.cause: Transaction revenue decline due to lower corporate bond and public finance activity
accepted.effect: revenue mix shift reducing transactional earnings volatility
accepted.evidence_span: Transaction revenue declined 1% to $368 million as declines in corporate bonds and public finance were slightly larger than gains in structured products.

accepted.cause: Platts revenue growth offset by reduced trading volumes from lower volatility
accepted.effect: margin compression concern on trading volume dependency
accepted.evidence_span: Platts: Revenue increased 3% to $196 million with growth in the core subscription business partially offset by a meaningful decline in Global Trading Services as reduced volatility in key commodity products resulted in lower trading volumes.
